title: Inception-style curved map for turn-by-turn directions
summary: Orbify demonstrates a creative navigation visualization approach using curved, Inception-style maps that fold the route path to show turn-by-turn directions in a non-traditional flat view. The demo reimagines how we perceive directional guidance by warping the map to make complex route changes more visually intuitive.
problem_solved: Makes complex turn-by-turn navigation more intuitive by visualizing routes as curved, dimensional paths rather than traditional flat 2D maps.
why_valuable: Offers a novel, visually striking approach to navigation that could improve spatial understanding and make directions more memorable for users.
